summary: National HealthCare Corporation filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing via Item 8.01 a press release issued November 5, 2026, announcing a routine quarterly common dividend of 67 cents per share. The dividend is payable January 29, 2027 to holders of record December 31, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are stated beyond the dividend. The filing is an ordinary current report on a capital-return announcement, not a special situation; the press release also recaps facility counts as of November 1, 2026. No deal or risk-arb angle applies.
